correctness.rationale: The published integral q=-x^2+xy-y^2+z^2 reduces identically to (z-x-y)(z+x+y) over F3. Together with the nine printed line factors this yields exactly all 13 ternary projective line classes except {z,x+y} or {x+y}; a projective enumeration supplies incidence counts at all 13 points and pair multiplicity totals 55,66. E=(x,y,z), D=(x^3,y^3,z^3), T8=P partial_y are logarithmic and det(E,D,T8)=f16. Direct polynomial reduction confirms P(x,y,0)=-y²(y-x)²(x+y)*y(y²-x²); thus T7=(T8+B(x²E-D))/z is polynomial and logarithmic on f15, det(E,D,T7)=f15. Saito criterion gives bases in arbitrary characteristic for reduced hyperplane arrangements. All geometric line intersections over algebraic closure are ternary rational points, not just a sample.
